name: samlee-inventory-desktop
description: TEK STOCK Singapore furniture inventory desktop application
author: SAMLEE

scripts.dist:msi: npm run test:workbook-identity && node build/verify-packaged-version.cjs && node inventory/verify-photo-lock.js && electron-builder --win msi --x64 && node build/harden-msi-local-install.cjs
scripts.dist:update: npm run test:workbook-identity && node build/verify-packaged-version.cjs && node inventory/verify-photo-lock.js && electron-builder --config build/electron-builder.update.cjs --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:remote: npm run test:workbook-identity && node build/verify-packaged-version.cjs && node inventory/verify-photo-lock.js && electron-builder --config build/electron-builder.remote.cjs --win nsis --x64
scripts.dist:win7: npm run test:workbook-identity && node build/verify-packaged-version.cjs && node inventory/verify-photo-lock.js && electron-builder --config build/electron-builder.win7.cjs --win msi --x64
